newsitem.title: UK: Barclays confirms in talks to sell Imry.
newsitem.headline: Barclays confirms in talks to sell Imry.

text.p: Barclays Plc said on Sunday it was in discussions concerning the sale of its property investment group Imry Holdings.
"Barclays has always made it clear it does not intend to be a long-term player in the property market and it has always held Imry with a view to subsequent resale," a Barclays spokesperson said.
"We are reviewing opportunities for realising value and this involves discussions with a number of parties including Chelsfield."
Earlier, the Sunday Times newspaper reported that UK property company Chelsfield Plc may be about to buy Imry.
The paper added that British Land is believed to be standing by the Chelsfield bid collapse.
"Although (Chelsfield owner Elliot) Bernerd is believed to be in advanced talks with Barclays, British Land is thought to be waiting in the wings should the deal fall through," the paper said.
